For odd n≥5, explicit periodic columns U and final blocks V5 or V7 satisfy the square-colouring condition in all 13 possible three-column windows. Repetition changes no window types, giving all orders; the standalone verifier independently enumerates small cases and tests the local table. Boundaries n3,5 included. This is a proof for all orders, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A complete natural invariant is determined on every circular ladder, capturing a parity transition between trivial 2-colour bipartite behavior and sharp 5-colour nonbipartite behavior plus the triangular exception. The explicit period-four colouring construction is constructive, uniform, and useful as a benchmark for strong odd colouring and comparison with square colouring on bounded-width cubic graphs; generic prior bounds did not determine the values.
